landing.heroSubtitle: Manage your church servants, members, attendance, events, and more — all in one platform.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything You Need to Manage Your Church
landing.featuresSubtitle: A complete suite of tools designed to streamline church management and community engagement.
landing.attendanceManagementDesc: QR-based attendance tracking with real-time validation. Never lose track of who attended.
landing.memberManagementDesc: Organize members by class years with detailed profiles, points tracking, and attendance history.
landing.servantManagementDesc: Assign servants to classes, track their performance, and manage their assigned members.
landing.eventsManagementDesc: Create and manage church events with image uploads, scheduling, and class targeting.
landing.qrAttendanceDesc: Secure token-based QR codes for attendance. No sensitive data in QR codes.
landing.analyticsDesc: Detailed analytics with attendance trends, servant performance, and member statistics.
landing.feedbackDesc: Members can submit feedback. Servants and admins can review and resolve issues.
landing.dailyVerseDesc: Set daily Bible verses for the whole church community to see and reflect on.
landing.roleAccessDesc: Granular permissions for Platform Admins, Church Admins, Servants, and Members.
landing.howItWorksTitle: Get Started in Three Simple Steps
landing.step1Desc: Submit your church information and ID verification. Our team reviews your application.
landing.step2Desc: Once approved, you become a Church Admin with full access to your church's dashboard.
landing.step3Desc: Add servants and members, manage attendance, create events, and track everything.
landing.benefitsSubtitle: Thousands of churches trust us to manage their communities effectively.
landing.benefitOrganizedDesc: Keep all church data — members, servants, attendance, events — in one centralized, easy-to-use system.
landing.benefitTrackingDesc: QR-based check-ins eliminate manual roll calls. Real-time tracking with instant points and rewards.
landing.benefitDigitalDesc: Cloud-based platform accessible from any device. No more paper records or lost data.
landing.benefitEngagementDesc: Track member participation, identify trends, and foster community through data-driven insights.
landing.footerTag: Empowering churches with modern management tools.
landing.footerAboutText: Church Manager is a comprehensive platform for managing church communities. We help churches streamline attendance, events, member management, and more.
landing.installTitle: Use Church Manager on Any Device
landing.installSubtitle: Install as a Progressive Web App on your phone, tablet, or computer. Works offline, loads instantly, and feels just like a native app.
landing.installFast: Fast loading — cached assets load instantly
landing.installOffline: Offline support — record attendance without internet
landing.installHome: Add to home screen — access with one tap
